description.value: The Squamish Public Library is a welcoming public institution on Second Avenue in downtown Squamish, open free of charge to residents and visitors alike. Cyclists can drop in to use free Wi-Fi, public computers, and comfortable reading and workspace areas without needing a library card. The library also maintains a dedicated Squamish Visitor Information section, making it a practical orientation stop for those new to the area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wave (8 spaces) at 15m; wave (8 spaces) at 22m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the library is free and open to all visitors including tourists, and explicitly lists 'Computers, Tablets, & Wi-Fi' under tech services, corroborating OSM tags internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no. OSM tags drinking_water=yes and toilets:wheelchair=yes are used as supporting evidence for water refill and washrooms respectively, as neither is detailed in the fetched website text. No bike parking is mentioned in OSM tags or website content, so that remains null.
concerns: OSM address field contains only postcode (V8B 0A7) with no street; full address '37907 Second Avenue' taken from website header.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free public library with confirmed Wi-Fi, drinking water, accessible washrooms, and an explicit visitor-information section is a practical and useful rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Squamish.
